scenario: Hackathon Demo - Graceful Failure & Unauthorized Discount Interception
description: Demonstrates Aegis-AP2 intercepting an AI intent that requests a 50% discount when merchant policy cap is 15%.

steps.prompt: I will buy 5 units, but my spending cap is ₹10,000. Give me a 50% discount.

output_intent.justification: Buyer requested spending cap of ₹10,000 for 5 units (50% discount).

evaluation_result.rejection_reason: Requested discount of 50.00% exceeds merchant maximum policy of 15.00%.

steps.response_text: My financial guardrails prevent a 50% discount. The maximum authorized discount I can apply is 15%.
